sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration Department: official eVisa service link
sources.officialityEvidence: The current SLID homepage identifies evisa.sl as its Official Portal and directs applicants there.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Apply online via the official Sierra Leone eVisa portal.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa: live terms and FAQ frontend text
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs / Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SLID directly authenticates evisa.sl. Its active frontend bundle contains the eligibility, approval-email and arrival-issuance statements used by the public application process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Countries with exception of all members of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS).

sources.title: National Tourist Board: Visa-on-arrival to Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The National Tourist Board keeps the 19 November 2019 Government VOA announcement live, but its date makes it insufficient to settle the current portal contradiction or a current exhaustive cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: With effect from Thursday 5th September 2019, a new Visa on Arrival policy has been rolled-out.

sources.title: ECOWAS current Member States
sources.publisher: Economic Community of West African States
sources.officialityEvidence: The Commission current member-state page confirms the twelve-State ECOWAS roster needed to interpret the eVisa exception.
